ei.title: Chapter 6-17 1번: Positive Emotions and Creative Thinking
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: People tend to assume that positive emotions are sources of simplistic or lazy thinking. Think of any highly creative person — such as Vincent van Gogh, Virginia Woolf, T. S. Eliot, or Charles Darwin — and you imagine their creative acts were produced during moments of struggle, tension, gloominess, and even despair. Alice Isen suggested that this view of creativity is wrong — that happiness instead prompts people to reason in ways that are flexible and creative. In her studies, Isen induced positive emotion in her participants with small events. She gave them little bags of candy, or they found a dime she had placed in their path. They watched amusing film clips. These subtle ways of making participants feel good produced striking changes in their reasoning. When given one word (such as carpet) and asked to generate a related word, people feeling positive emotions came up with more novel associations (fresh or texture) than people in a neutral state, who tended to produce more common responses (such as rug). People feeling positive categorized objects in more inclusive ways, rating fringe members of categories (like cane or purse as an example of clothing) as better members of that category than people in a neutral state, whose categories tended to be more narrowly defined.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 미묘한 방법들이 추론에 '두드러진 변화(striking changes)'를 낳았다
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤에 긍정 감정의 사람들과 중립 상태의 사람들 사이의 뚜렷한 차이(연상·분류)가 제시되므로 큰 변화가 있었다는 말이 필요.
❌ ① no visible differences(눈에 띄는 차이 없음): 뒤 예시와 정반대
❌ ② slower reactions(더 느린 반응): 반응 속도는 다루지 않음
✅ ③ striking changes(두드러진 변화): 뒤이어 제시되는 큰 차이와 연결되는 정답 ←정답
❌ ④ weaker memories(약해진 기억): 기억이 아니라 추론·분류의 변화
det.tip: produced striking changes in their reasoning → 뒤 예시가 그 큰 변화

det.korean: 행복은 사람들이 '유연하고 창의적인(flexible and creative)' 방식으로 추론하도록 촉발한다

✅ ① 원문 'happiness instead prompts people to reason in ways that are flexible and creative'와 일치 ←정답
❌ ② 긍정 감정이 단순 사고로 이어진다는 것은 Isen이 반박한 통념
❌ ③ 참신한 연상은 긍정 감정의 사람들 특징(중립 상태 아님)
